subject.title: MCP: render large JSON tool outputs as structured artifacts/previews

question: Should OpenClaw introduce a generic persisted artifact/reference contract for oversized tool results, or keep result shaping and pagination plugin/MCP-server-owned behind the existing tool-result middleware?
rationale: Current main has generic collapsible inspection and plugin result-shaping seams, but neither establishes the privacy, persistence, protocol, and UI ownership rules for automatic full-JSON artifacts.

options.title: Design a generic artifact contract
options.body: Define a typed result reference and one Control UI retrieval flow, then let MCP and plugins opt into it without adding per-server UI logic.

options.title: Keep it plugin-owned
options.body: Document a plugin/MCP middleware pattern that summarizes selected outputs and offers domain-specific pagination without changing core transcript or artifact contracts.

recommendation.title: Design a generic artifact contract
recommendation.body: Define a typed result reference and one Control UI retrieval flow, then let MCP and plugins opt into it without adding per-server UI logic.

likelyOwner.reason: The existing cross-harness tool-result middleware boundary is the most direct technical starting point for this product choice.
